scope: Independent read-only review of staged implementations, runners, tests, protocols, readouts, README and claims against declared experimental scope. Reviewer executed selected tests directly from staged source in memory; did not rerun full suite or independently audit large artifact contents.

suggestions.suggestion: Extend replay-pair assertions to retained observation/release parent receipts and information Markdown summaries.
suggestions.disposition: Retained as non-blocking coverage suggestion. Parent receipt equality was already verified through real execution; final pre-commit readback additionally compares all suggested pairs. No implementation or frozen experiment changed after review.

summary: No material security or logic errors found. Contract-relative sufficiency is separate from policy certification; logging and attestation assumptions and cost exclusions are explicit. Unsafe or incomplete-service policies are not eligible cost winners.
